children: Vietnam's State Treasury raised 15 trillion dong ($578 million) in its weekly government bond auction on Wednesday, up from $97 million raised last week.
The uptake was higher, with 68% of the bonds on offer sold, compared with 15% last week, according to a Hanoi Stock Exchange filing.
